Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Timebox: 25-minute exploratory call — two timezone-friendly options

Hi Ravi,

Thanks for applying to the Software Engineer, Inference role — excited to chat. I'm Grace on the recruiting team at Redwood. We try to keep first screens tightly timeboxed so they're easy to schedule and respectful of evenings. Would either of the two 25-minute options below work for you?

Option A (short morning in IST):
- Mon Oct 12, 8:30 PM IST / Mon Oct 12, 11:00 AM GMT / Mon Oct 12, 03:00 AM PDT

Option B (early US-friendly):
- Tue Oct 13, 9:15 AM PDT / Tue Oct 13, 12:15 PM EDT / Tue Oct 13, 17:15 BST

If neither fits, tell me three windows that do (date + local time) and I'll propose an invite. I attached a one-page role overview and an ICS stub so you can preview the calendar details.

Also: could you confirm the resume version you'd like us to use (attached or alternate link)?

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_role_onepager.pdf (PDF), placeholder: redwood_intro.ics (calendar invite stub)
